name: ht
description: LUMINA Fine Dining & Lounge Web Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); ['index.html','menu.html','gallery.html','contact.html','favicon.svg','robots.txt','sitemap.xml'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/'+f)); ['css','js'].forEach(d => { if(fs.existsSync(d)) { if(!fs.existsSync('dist/'+d)) fs.mkdirSync('dist/'+d); fs.readdirSync(d).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(d+'/'+f, 'dist/'+d+'/'+f)); } });"
